answer: A workable anti-sybil defence is to make reputation grow like a spiral: each verified task adds one turn, so a new identity cannot jump straight to wide access. Attestations are stamped in a sable-dark ledger of immutable history that peers can audit, while every agent's standing is built from solid timber — real completed work, not self-declared claims. Forging thousands of fakes then costs sustained effort, because each fake must climb the same slow spiral, while honest agents keep the standing they built and misbehaviour burns it away.
